answer.original_source: Valar Atomics and Nvidia; Deseret News reports their announcement and plans.
answer.new_information: The companies are considering a specific 30-megawatt Utah data center using Valar’s Ward250 reactor and Nvidia cooling technology, described as nearly waterless. This adds project size, location, and proposed technology to the broader partnership announcement in item:e1, but remains exploratory rather than a committed deployment. The article reports the Ward250 was generating 100 kilowatts as of 2026-07-01 and says NRC licensing is required before Valar can generate power commercially. The proposed facility’s near-waterless characterization is not an independent performance test. No linked research questions or catalog were supplied, and this record carries no distinct investment judgement to propose as a new question.
